To identify other risk loci, we conducted a large genome-wide association study of 2,032 individuals… 24530130 genome-wide-association-study-identifies-variants-at-clu-and-cr1-associated-with-alzheimer's-disease genome wide association study identifies variants at clu The gene encoding apolipoprotein E (APOE) on chromosome 19 is the only confirmed susceptibility loc Genome-wide association study identifies variants at CLU and CR1 associated with Alzheimer's disease The gene encoding apolipoprotein E (APOE) on chromosome 19 is the only confirmed susceptibility locus for late-onset Alzheimer's disease. To identify other risk loci, we conducted a large genome-wide association study of 2,032 individuals from France with Alzheimer's disease (cases) and 5,328 controls. Markers outside APOE with suggestive evidence of association (P < 10−5) were examined in collections from Belgium, Finland, Italy and Spain totaling 3,978 Alzheimer's disease cases and 3,297 controls.
